content: Deduplicating an append-only log by a coarse key collapses distinct events that share that key, converting a cosmetic duplication problem into silent data loss. The safe form is content-addressing over the full event payload (a digest of what actually differs), not over a human-readable label; deduping by label makes the first occurrence permanent and swallows every later, genuinely different event under the same label. Second hazard: dedupe that no-ops after an id has been allocated breaks any downstream invariant of the form ids-issued == records-written.
